description: Defines classes and structures related to congestion control loss detection algorithms, specifically UberLossAlgorithm and associated interfaces, within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: LossDetectionParameters
classes.description: Holds parameters for loss detection, including reordering shift and threshold.

classes.name: LossDetectionTunerInterface
classes.description: Interface for tuning loss detection parameters during QUIC sessions.

classes.name: UberLossAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements multiple loss detection algorithms for different packet number spaces, with adaptive tuning capabilities.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the loss algorithm based on provided QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: DetectLosses
methods.description: Detects lost packets based on current unacknowledged packets and network conditions.

methods.name: GetLossTimeout
methods.description: Returns the earliest time to trigger loss detection retransmission.

methods.name: SpuriousLossDetected
methods.description: Adjusts detection parameters when a spurious loss is detected.

methods.name: SetLossDetectionTuner
methods.description: Assigns a loss detection tuner for adaptive parameter tuning.

methods.name: OnMinRttAvailable
methods.description: Handles actions when minimum RTT is available.

methods.name: OnUserAgentIdKnown
methods.description: Handles actions when user agent information is known.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup or adjustments when a connection closes.

methods.name: SetReorderingShift
methods.description: Sets the reordering shift parameter for all packet spaces.

methods.name: SetReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Sets the reordering threshold for all packet spaces.

methods.name: GetPacketReorderingThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the current packet reordering threshold.

methods.name: GetPacketReorderingShift
methods.description: Retrieves the current packet reordering shift.

methods.name: DisablePacketThresholdForRuntPackets
methods.description: Disables threshold-based detection for runt packets.

methods.name: ResetLossDetection
methods.description: Resets loss detection state for a given packet number space.
